story.text: 有只小东西抱着枯枝，一动不动。刺猬隔着草看了半天，伸鼻尖碰一下，才发现它背上裂开了：这是一副空蝉蜕，六只细足还紧紧扣住树皮。昨天标本屋的空壳卧在台上，今天这副空壳却把自己挂得牢牢的。你想看它带回一件自己的小发现，它便把已经落地的这小段枯枝一起托起来，轻轻送回苔石边。给你看的，是淡琥珀色的空蝉蜕和它抱住的短枝，背上的裂口透着光。它没把脆壳拔下来，而是将短枝的两端架在半壳收藏区侧边，让蝉蜕继续抱着自己的东西。
story.homeIntent: 新增抱住短枝的空蝉蜕，短枝两端架在半壳收藏区侧边，避免压到纸卡及床边干草；原种子、木片、凹口石、明信片、照片全部延续。

visuals.request:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: a discovered object presented to the user, not a scene illustration or photo card.
Primary request: Draw ONLY one pale amber EMPTY CICADA EXUVIA still gripping one short piece of dry fallen twig. It is a delicate shed insect shell, visibly hollow and uninhabited, with a head casing, short antenna remnants, a broad empty thorax and segmented tapering abdomen. Exactly six slender curled legs, three on each side, wrap around and hook into the rough twig bark; choose a slightly elevated three-quarter view that separates the six leg silhouettes and clearly exposes the long open split on the dorsal back. The split opens into the hollow body; daylight passes through thin amber shell edges and the empty opening. No living insect inside, no wings. The whole short twig and intact shed casing are visible with room around them.
Style/medium: charming carefully simplified pixel illustration of a found natural object, crisp stepped pixel contours, clear amber and warm brown color blocks with a few lighter translucent shell highlights. This is a small fragile specimen, not a monster or a pet.
Composition/framing: centered object-only composition, square image, twig runs diagonally from lower left to upper right, shell clings atop the center of the twig; clean readable silhouette and all shell organs unobscured.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent background, no surface or scenery.
Constraints: only the exuvia and short supporting twig. No live cicada, hedgehog, person, hands, room, landscape, display stand, labels, text, frame, paper border or watermark. Do not detach the legs from the twig or replace the hollow casing with a solid insect body.
